skill_name: Distributed Systems, Message Brokers & Event Driven Architecture
question_text:
Implement an enterprise backend service component for **Challenge #38: Distributed Systems, Message Brokers & Event Driven Architecture**.

### Problem Specification:
- Write an asynchronous or transactional backend routine (e.g., token bucket limiter, connection retry backoff, queue consumer, or idempotent deduplicator).
- Guarantee thread-safety and handle transient timeouts.
- Avoid resource leaks and ensure clean connection lifecycle.
answer_explanation: Demonstrates atomic state check and idempotent execution guarantee in Distributed Systems, Message Brokers & Event Driven Architecture.

criteria.name: Functional Correctness
criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.

criteria.name: Code Structure & Cleanliness
criteria.description: Idiomatic naming, handling edge boundaries and null guards.
